profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented obstacle detection and dynamic tool path planning 
- Designed and prototyped quality analysis of finished wall surfaces

positions.title: Machine Vision Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented the vision pipeline for the Canvas robotic platform ground up 
- Implemented visual SLAM as early prototype for robot navigation
- Implemented sensor fusion to obtain 3D colored point-cloud of interior walls.

positions.title: Imaging Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with an incredible team of machine vision enthusiasts responsible for developing , prototyping and testing  machine vision algorithms to aid the system of smart farming techniques developed and monitored by Mavrx Inc.
-Increased average match accuracy of multi-sensor images from 0.4 to 0.9 by implementing a new aligning algorithm based on enhanced correlation co-efficient .
- Implemented scalable solutions to provide support to host processing on Google Cloud.
- Developed image processing algorithms for plant row detection and estimating  the corn plant count .

Tools - Python , C++ , QGIS , Gdal , Docker

positions.title: Machine Vision Intern
positions.description:

Tools - Python , C++ , QGIS , Gdal

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:
Worked on an Audio processing project titled , "Can we perceive the location of a source in an enclosure from the timbre of its RIR? "
 
- Designed and implemented the Room Impulse Response Measurement Techniques
- Gained sound knowledge in Acoustics and Gammatone filter-bank auditory model.
- Designed the perception test and conducted subject validation.

Tools Used : MATLAB, MUSHRA, PlayRec

projects.title: Forest Cover Type Prediction
projects.description:
A Machine learning classification project to predict the forest cover type (the predominant kind of tree cover) from strictly cartographic variables.

- Implemented various classifiers like ADABOOST , Random Forest , ExtraTrees .

- Performed Feature Engineering Techniques to improve the test data multi-class classification rate.

- Obtained the 127 th Rank on the Kaggle Leadership Board for this competition  
Software : Python

projects.title: Computer Vision
projects.description:
- Implemented object detection using SIFT and bag of features using OpenCV .
- Implemented an affine reconstruction algorithm to reconstruct a 3-D object from multiple uncalibrated cameras.

publications.title: Using Hough Transform to classify polygons for pattern identification in chip layout design
